hook.en: Your class has two students named Rahul. When the teacher enters marks, how does the computer know which Rahul is which? It uses a key.
hook.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ತರಗತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಹುಲ್ ಎಂಬ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಇದ್ದಾರೆ. ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಅಂಕ ನಮೂದಿಸುವಾಗ ಯಾವ ರಾಹುಲ್ ಎಂದು ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತು? ಅದು ಕೀಲಿಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Identify candidate, primary, alternate and composite primary keys
Explain foreign keys and how they link relations

narration.en: Your class has two students named Rahul. When the teacher enters marks, how does the computer know which Rahul is which? It uses a key.
narration.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ತರಗತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಹುಲ್ ಎಂಬ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಇದ್ದಾರೆ. ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಅಂಕ ನಮೂದಿಸುವಾಗ ಯಾವ ರಾಹುಲ್ ಎಂದು ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತು? ಅದು ಕೀಲಿಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: A candidate key is an attribute (or minimal set of attributes) whose values uniquely identify every tuple. The designer selects one candidate key as the primary key; the remaining candidate keys are alternate keys. When no single attribute is unique, two or more attributes together can form a composite primary key. A primary key cannot be NULL.

points.en: Candidate key: can identify tuples uniquely
Primary key: the chosen candidate key; never NULL
Alternate key: candidate key not chosen
Composite primary key: two or more attributes

narration.en: Any attribute that can uniquely identify rows is a candidate key. One is chosen as the primary key, the rest are alternate keys, and a key made of two or more attributes is a composite key.
narration.kn: ಸಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಅನನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ಗುಣಲಕ್ಷಣ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿ ಕೀಲಿ. ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯಾದದ್ದು ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಕೀಲಿ, ಉಳಿದವು ಪರ್ಯಾಯ ಕೀಲಿಗಳು; ಎರಡು ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಗುಣಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳಿಂದಾದದ್ದು ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಕೀಲಿ.

body.en: A foreign key is an attribute in one relation whose values come from the primary key of another (referenced) relation. It links the two relations. A foreign key value must either match an existing primary-key value or be NULL, so we cannot record attendance for a roll number that does not exist.

points.en: Value must exist in the referenced primary key, or be NULL
May repeat in its own relation

narration.en: A foreign key links two tables. Its value must exist as a primary key in the other table, or be NULL.
narration.kn: ವಿದೇಶಿ ಕೀಲಿ ಎರಡು ಕೋಷ್ಟಕಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದರ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದ ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಕೀಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇರಬೇಕು ಅಥವಾ NULL ಆಗಿರಬೇಕು.

problem.en: STUDENT(RollNo, SName, GUID, Phone) where RollNo and GUID are unique for every student, and ATTENDANCE(AttDate, RollNo, Status). Identify all keys.

steps.en: STUDENT: RollNo and GUID each identify a student → candidate keys.
Choose RollNo as the primary key → GUID becomes an alternate key.
ATTENDANCE: a roll number repeats daily and a date repeats for all students, so {AttDate, RollNo} together is the composite primary key.
ATTENDANCE.RollNo refers to STUDENT.RollNo → foreign key.

answer.en: Candidate: RollNo, GUID; primary: RollNo; alternate: GUID; composite PK of ATTENDANCE: {AttDate, RollNo}; foreign key: ATTENDANCE.RollNo

narration.en: Let us work through this together. STUDENT(RollNo, SName, GUID, Phone) where RollNo and GUID are unique for every student, and ATTENDANCE(AttDate, RollNo, Status). Identify all keys.

body.en: All the keys that could identify a row stand for election (candidates). One wins (primary). The losers stay as alternates. A key borrowed from another table is a foreigner.

narration.en: All the keys that could identify a row stand for election (candidates). One wins (primary). The losers stay as alternates. A key borrowed from another table is a foreigner.

mnemonic.en: Candidates contest, Primary wins, Alternates wait, Foreigners visit

narration.en: Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two board and CUET pattern questions. Read each one carefully before you answer.
These are CBSE board pattern questions: assertion–reason and case-based. Read the passage or both statements before choosing.

points.en: Candidate keys can uniquely identify tuples.
One is chosen as the primary key; others are alternate keys.
points.kn: ಒಂದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಕೀಲಿಯಾಗಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇವೆ; ಉಳಿದವು ಪರ್ಯಾಯ ಕೀಲಿಗಳು.

points.en: A composite primary key has two or more attributes.
points.kn: ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಕೀಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಗುಣಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳಿವೆ.

points.en: A foreign key refers to the primary key of another relation.
points.kn: ವಿದೇಶಿ ಕೀಲಿ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಸಂಬಂಧದ ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಕೀಲಿಯನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

homework.en: For a hospital with PATIENT, DOCTOR and APPOINTMENT relations, choose primary and foreign keys.

narration.en: Recap. Candidate keys can uniquely identify tuples. One is chosen as the primary key; others are alternate keys. A composite primary key has two or more attributes. A foreign key refers to the primary key of another relation.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿ ಕೀಲಿಗಳು ಟ್ಯೂಪಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಅನನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಗುರುತಿಸಬಲ್ಲವು. ಒಂದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಕೀಲಿಯಾಗಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇವೆ; ಉಳಿದವು ಪರ್ಯಾಯ ಕೀಲಿಗಳು. ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಕೀಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಗುಣಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳಿವೆ. ವಿದೇಶಿ ಕೀಲಿ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಸಂಬಂಧದ ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಕೀಲಿಯನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
